  "description": "Royale Resources &amp; Consults is a professional recruitment and workforce solutions company dedicated to connecting qualified candidates with reputable employers. We specialize in sourcing, screening, and deploying reliable personnel to meet the staffing needs of individuals, households, and organizations.

Our services cover a wide range of roles including domestic staff, drivers, security personnel, administrative staff, chefs, cleaners, and other skilled and support personnel. Through a structured recruitment and verification process, we ensure that only competent and trustworthy candidates are recommended to our clients.

At Royale Resources &amp; Consults, our goal is to simplify the hiring process while helping employers access dependable talent and providing&nbsp;job seekers with meaningful employment opportunities. We are committed to professionalism, integrity, and delivering staffing solutions that support the growth and productivity of our clients.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Boutique Manager&nbsp;

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are seeking a professional, experienced and results-driven Boutique Manager to oversee the daily operations of a luxury unisex fashion boutique.
	The successful candidate will manage the sales team, drive revenue, maintain excellent customer service and ensure the boutique consistently delivers a premium shopping experience.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage the day-to-day operations of the boutique.
	Supervise, coordinate and motivate sales staff.
	Monitor sales performance and work towards achieving business targets.
	Develop strategies to increase sales and customer retention.
	Provide excellent customer service and resolve customer complaints professionally.
	Ensure clothing, shoes, bags, jewellery and other products are properly displayed.
	Monitor stock levels, inventory movement and product availability.
	Maintain accurate sales, stock and operational records.
	Supervise POS and payment transactions and ensure proper accountability.
	Coordinate product arrivals, pricing, promotions and special offers.
	Ensure the boutique maintains a clean, organised and luxurious appearance.
	Build strong relationships with new and existing customers.
	Support social media marketing and online customer engagement.
	Prepare regular sales and operational reports for management.
	Ensure staff follow company policies, procedures and professional standards.


Required Skills &amp; Competencies


	Candidates should possess a Bachelor&#39;s Degree / HND / Master Degree / NCE / OND qualification with 1 - 2 years experience.
	Strong leadership and team-management skills.
	Excellent sales and negotiation skills.
	Strong customer service and relationship-management abilities.
	Excellent verbal and written communication.
	Good knowledge of fashion, retail and current market trends.
	Strong organisational and multitasking abilities.
	Good problem-solving and decision-making skills.
	Knowledge of POS systems and basic inventory management.
	Social media and digital marketing skills are an advantage.
	Ability to analyse sales performance and identify opportunities for growth.
	Professional, confident and well-presented.
	Trustworthy, responsible and detail-oriented.
	Ability to work independently and under pressure.
	Passion for delivering a premium luxury retail experience.


Salary
N150,000 - N200,000 monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Updated CV and two (2) clear photographs to: royaleresourcesng@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.&nbsp;

Note


	For more enquiries, WhatsApp: 0810 270 0687
	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Boutique Manager Job at Royale Resources & Consults




        
    

        
        Royale Resources & Consults is a professional recruitment and workforce solutions company dedicated to connecting qualified candidates with reputable employers. We specialize in sourcing, screening, and deploying reliable personnel to meet the staffing needs of individuals, households, and organizations.

Our services cover a wide range of roles including domestic staff, drivers, security personnel, administrative staff, chefs, cleaners, and other skilled and support personnel. Through a structured recruitment and verification process, we ensure that only competent and trustworthy candidates are recommended to our clients.
     

            
    



At Royale Resources & Consults, our goal is to simplify the hiring process while helping employers access dependable talent and providing job seekers with meaningful employment opportunities. We are committed to professionalism, integrity, and delivering staffing solutions that support the growth and productivity of our clients.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Boutique Manager 

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are seeking a professional, experienced and results-driven Boutique Manager to oversee the daily operations of a luxury unisex fashion boutique.
	The successful candidate will manage the sales team, drive revenue, maintain excellent customer service and ensure the boutique consistently delivers a premium shopping experience.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage the day-to-day operations of the boutique.
	Supervise, coordinate and motivate sales staff.
	Monitor sales performance and work towards achieving business targets.
	Develop strategies to increase sales and customer retention.
	Provide excellent customer service and resolve customer complaints professionally.
	Ensure clothing, shoes, bags, jewellery and other products are properly displayed.
	Monitor stock levels, inventory movement and product availability.
	Maintain accurate sales, stock and operational records.
	Supervise POS and payment transactions and ensure proper accountability.
	Coordinate product arrivals, pricing, promotions and special offers.
	Ensure the boutique maintains a clean, organised and luxurious appearance.
	Build strong relationships with new and existing customers.
	Support social media marketing and online customer engagement.
	Prepare regular sales and operational reports for management.
	Ensure staff follow company policies, procedures and professional standards.


Required Skills & Competencies


	Candidates should possess a Bachelor's Degree / HND / Master Degree / NCE / OND qualification with 1 - 2 years experience.
	Strong leadership and team-management skills.
	Excellent sales and negotiation skills.
	Strong customer service and relationship-management abilities.
	Excellent verbal and written communication.
	Good knowledge of fashion, retail and current market trends.
	Strong organisational and multitasking abilities.
	Good problem-solving and decision-making skills.
	Knowledge of POS systems and basic inventory management.
	Social media and digital marketing skills are an advantage.
	Ability to analyse sales performance and identify opportunities for growth.
	Professional, confident and well-presented.
	Trustworthy, responsible and detail-oriented.
	Ability to work independently and under pressure.
	Passion for delivering a premium luxury retail experience.


Salary
N150,000 - N200,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Updated CV and two (2) clear photographs to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email. 

Note


	For more enquiries, WhatsApp: 0810 270 0687
	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Electrical Maintenance Technician I Job at Habrams Energy




        
    

        
        Habrams Energy offers you engineering, procurement, construction management, operations, and maintenance services for oil & gas projects in the Gulf of Guinea. We provide specialist solutions to international oil companies, marginal field operators, and service companies.

Our work ranges from retrofitting and de-bottlenecking to designing complete facilities â€“ with seamless transition from construction to operations.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Electrical Maintenance Technician I

Job Location: Akwa Ibom
Job Type: Full time

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are seeking a skilled and safety-conscious Electrical Maintenance Technician I to support field electrical maintenance activities, electrical isolation (LOTO), and preventive/breakdown maintenance for lighting, air-conditioning, and motor systems.


Key Responsibilities


	Verify and issue electrical work permits to contractors for lighting, air-conditioning, and motor maintenance activities.
	Supervise contractors and ensure strict compliance with safety requirements, immediately intervening where unsafe acts are observed.
	Participate in Job Safety Analysis (JSA) reviews with contractors.
	Execute scheduled maintenance activities and promptly escalate unresolved issues to the First Line Supervisor (FLS).
	Monitor contractors’ work quality to ensure compliance with Maintenance Procedures & Practices (MPP) and minimize rework.
	Provide daily progress updates to the FLS and maintenance planner.
	Obtain FLS approval before implementing any changes to approved work plans.
	Verify and accept completed maintenance work.


Requirements


	Previous experience in electrical maintenance or a closely related role, preferably within the Oil & Gas industry.
	Relevant technical/discipline certification or equivalent professional experience.
	Good understanding of electrical isolation and Lock Out/Tag Out (LOTO) procedures.
	Strong communication and field reporting skills.
	Ability to work effectively as part of a team and collaborate with contractors and other stakeholders.
	Ability to work under tight deadlines, manage heavy workloads, and adapt to changing priorities.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

SBC has recently entered into Home &amp; Personal Care category with the 2SURE brand and launched its first product, a Hand &amp; Surface Sanitizer. Seven Up boasts of nine bottling plants with state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities strategically located across various regions in the country.&nbsp;

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Project Manager (Engineer)

Position Overview


	The project engineer is responsible for the coordination with the various plants and departments to during the implementation of the project and conducts periodical review of the project status.


Responsibilities


	Ensuring Safety first and following all the safety norms
	Coordinating with cross-discipline team members to make sure that all parties are on track with project requirements, deadlines, and schedules.
	Understanding the technical requirements of each equipment including P&amp; IDs
	Follow with Plant Team for any stoppage &amp;any other project requirement.
	Following with Plant to fulfil any legal requirement.
	Understanding BOQs of Civil, Mechanical, Piping &amp;Electrical
	Ensuring no deviation in the contracts signed by the vendors.
	Preparation of Gantt Chart in liasoning with all the selected vendors
	Ensuring no cost overshooting &amp;if there is any risk, escalating to Project Head Immediately.
	Monitoring the risks continuously &amp;planning mitigation plan in coordination with Project Head.
	Timely follow-up of procurement requirements.
	Timely follow-up payments for vendors.
	Daily update &amp;Weekly reports to Project Head.
	Ensuring proper logistics for the site team in coordination with plant HR.


Qualifications


	A minimum of Bachelor of Engineering Degree (B.Eng.) or HND in Mechanical Engineering.
	Must have 5 &ndash; 7 years of relevant hands-on experience in technical project engineering.
	At least 4 years of experience in a beverage bottling company.
	Must know AutoCAD &amp;MS Office. Should be able to do scheduling in MS Projects.
	Experienced in budgeting and people management
	Knowledge of bottling operations: Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, Environment
	Must Possess PMP CERTIFICATION or similar
	Project Management certification will be an added advantage.
	Experience in plant manufacturing operations, project planning &amp;implementation.

Project Manager (Engineer) Job at Seven-Up Bottling Company Limited




        
    

        
        Seven-Up Bottling Company Limited is one of the largest manufacturing companies in Nigeria, producing and distributing some of the nation’s most- loved beverages in the country like; Pepsi, 7Up, Mirinda, Teem, Mountain Dew, H2oH!, Lipton Ice Tea and Aquafina premium drinking water. SBC has recently entered into Home & Personal Care category with the 2SURE brand and launched its first product, a Hand & Surface Sanitizer. Seven Up boasts of nine bottling plants with state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities strategically located across various regions in the country. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Project Manager (Engineer)
     

            
    



Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Position Overview


	The project engineer is responsible for the coordination with the various plants and departments to during the implementation of the project and conducts periodical review of the project status.


Responsibilities


	Ensuring Safety first and following all the safety norms
	Coordinating with cross-discipline team members to make sure that all parties are on track with project requirements, deadlines, and schedules.
	Understanding the technical requirements of each equipment including P& IDs
	Follow with Plant Team for any stoppage &any other project requirement.
	Following with Plant to fulfil any legal requirement.
	Understanding BOQs of Civil, Mechanical, Piping &Electrical
	Ensuring no deviation in the contracts signed by the vendors.
	Preparation of Gantt Chart in liasoning with all the selected vendors
	Ensuring no cost overshooting &if there is any risk, escalating to Project Head Immediately.
	Monitoring the risks continuously &planning mitigation plan in coordination with Project Head.
	Timely follow-up of procurement requirements.
	Timely follow-up payments for vendors.
	Daily update &Weekly reports to Project Head.
	Ensuring proper logistics for the site team in coordination with plant HR.


Qualifications


	A minimum of Bachelor of Engineering Degree (B.Eng.) or HND in Mechanical Engineering.
	Must have 5 – 7 years of relevant hands-on experience in technical project engineering.
	At least 4 years of experience in a beverage bottling company.
	Must know AutoCAD &MS Office. Should be able to do scheduling in MS Projects.
	Experienced in budgeting and people management
	Knowledge of bottling operations: Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, Environment
	Must Possess PMP CERTIFICATION or similar
	Project Management certification will be an added advantage.
	Experience in plant manufacturing operations, project planning &implementation.
	Previous new equipment or line installation or extension could be an advantageengi
